title: "Analyzing US Census Data"
author: "Mayah"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| cache: true
income_tx <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = "B19013_001",
  year = 2020,
  state = "TX",
  geometry = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
#| label: texas-income-map
income_tx |>
  filter(!is.na(estimate)) |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = estimate), color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(labels = scales::label_dollar()) +
  labs(
    title = "Median Household Income by Texas County",
    fill = "Annual income",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 American Community Survey (ACS) 5-year estimates."
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0)
  )
```
